```{r}
options(scipen = 999)
```

# Dependencies

```{r}
library(dplyr) # for %>%, rename(), filter(), mutate(), select(), group_by(), summarize()
library(readr) # for read_csv(), write_csv()
```

# Load original data

```{r}
dat_demographics_private <- read_csv("../data/raw/private/study-irasdo_demographics_raw_data.csv")
```

# Remove identifiers

The email addresses and the free-text comments were removed because they contain identifying information (the comments contain names). I read them before removal. One participant reported completing the study together with another person, so their responses may not be independent. I did not exclude this participant, because the assignment defines the exclusion criteria and comments are not among them.

```{r}
dat_demographics_deidentified <- dat_demographics_private %>%
  select(- "...2", - "...5")
```

# Write de-identified data

```{r}
dat_demographics_deidentified %>% 
  write_csv("../data/raw/study-irasdo_task-demographics_stage-raw_data.csv")
```
